## Working papers

[Paper 1]{#paper-1 .fw-bold}\
*Under review*\
Unpartnered adult children are not one group. Children who became single through divorce or widowhood receive different support from their parents than children who never married.

- **Data:** SHARE, parent–child dyads in 16 European countries
- **Methods:** generalized estimating equations (population-averaged logistic models)
